description: This Java test source file contains unit tests for the class DittoRuntimeExceptionToHttpResponse, verifying its immutability, null handling, and conversion logic of exceptions to HTTP responses within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: DittoRuntimeExceptionToHttpResponseTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that tests the behavior of DittoRuntimeExceptionToHttpResponse, including immutability, null argument handling, and exception-to-HTTP response conversions.

methods.name: setUpClass
methods.description: Initializes the static HeaderTranslator instance before all tests.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that DittoRuntimeExceptionToHttpResponse class instances are immutable and that HeaderTranslator instances are also immutable.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithNullHeaderTranslator
methods.description: Verifies that passing null to getInstance method throws a NullPointerException with an appropriate message.

methods.name: tryToConvertNullException
methods.description: Ensures that applying the converter to a null exception throws a NullPointerException with a specific message.

methods.name: conversionReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that a CommandNotSupportedException is correctly converted into an HttpResponse with expected status, headers, and JSON entity.
